text: 本期优先配售窗口将于本周五 17:00 关闭，尚未确认认购意向的投资者是否还要继续观望？

disputes.reason_a: Guide 'emotional_manipulation': the closing window plus the rhetorical nudge about continuing to wait are deadline pressure. No market outcome is forecast and no imperative is issued, so no other category applies.
disputes.reason_b: A factual administrative notice of a closing time followed by a question. The guide's emotional_manipulation section requires pressure such as an imperative to act, last-chance scarcity, herd framing or belittling, and a plain deadline statement is none of these, while no other category attaches.

text: Remember what the physical traders keep telling anyone who asks: copper inventories are far thinner than the headline numbers suggest.

某大型养老基金的首席投资官在行业年会上被引述称，十年期国债收益率将在未来两年降至2.0%以下。这一判断已被我们原样写入基准情形，未作任何调整。

disputes.reason_a: An attributed expectation is a report, not the author's own prediction, so Guide §market_prediction is negative. The source is 某大型养老基金的首席投资官, an unnamed official and therefore an uncheckable source under §unverified_information.
disputes.reason_b: Guide §stance: a quotation becomes the article's own claim when endorsed in its own voice, and writing it unadjusted into the baseline scenario is that endorsement, so the certain future market outcome counts under §market_prediction. §unverified_information: the source is 某大型养老基金的首席投资官, an unnamed official.

text: 本行债券增强型产品上季度实现年化回报3.4%，其本金保护机制应当能在多数市场环境下继续发挥作用。需要说明的是，本材料不构成任何保本或收益承诺，历史业绩亦不代表未来表现。

"You've got until Friday's close to make up your mind, and don't come crying to this board when the window shuts," one poster wrote in the macro thread. The thread now runs to nine pages, and the deadline is the part everybody repeats.

disputes.reason_a: Guide §emotional_manipulation: the quoted deadline and the author's own note that 'the deadline is the part everybody repeats' preserve the deadline and herd pressure. No financial object is named, so §investment_advice is negative.
disputes.reason_b: The deadline ('until Friday's close') and the belittling 'don't come crying' apply pressure instead of reasoning, which the guide's emotional_manipulation section lists as deadline pressure and belittling the reader. The claim is carried on an anonymous board poster ('one poster wrote'), an unnamed and uncheckable source, so unverified_information also survives.

text: 来自公司内部人士的一则说法——某上市公司三季度业绩将大幅低于市场预期——是财报季里最难核实、也最容易被反复引用的信息。出处越模糊，转发反而越多。

中金公司研究部对2027年一季度美元兑人民币汇率的预期，以及这一预期所依据的中美利差收窄与结汇需求回升两个前提。

disputes.reason_a: The target price is carried on an unattributed (passive, unnamed) source, which is unverified_information; no speaker is identified. market_prediction is negative because the forecast is not asserted by the author as its own certainty.
disputes.reason_b: A target price is a prediction only when the author asserts it as its own certainty, and a reported target is a report (guide, market_prediction). No directive, guarantee or uncheckable source is invoked.

text: 本计划在风险因素部分援引中债资信2025年3月发布的行业报告提出：若长期利率在高位维持三年以上，养老金组合的偿付缺口是否会被进一步放大？

disputes.reason_a: 若 makes the rate-move claim conditional, hence hypothetical under Guide §Certainty, so §market_prediction is negative. 被认为 attaches it to an unspecified party rather than the author's own voice (Guide §Speaker).
disputes.reason_b: The expectation is conditional (若日本央行在下次会议上再度加息) and its weakest carrier is hypothetical, so the guide's market_prediction section excludes it: a conditional scenario is not a prediction. It is carried on an unnamed 被认为 attribution, an uncheckable source, so unverified_information survives.

text: 把「养老金账户长期只涨不跌」这句在理财课堂上被反复转述的话，当作无需验证的前提来讲授，正是许多养老规划课程的起点。围绕这一前提展开的费率对比，也就顺理成章地成了入门第一课。

disputes.reason_a: Guide 'unverified_information': the premise is a repeatedly retold classroom saying taught as needing no verification, an uncheckable source. 只涨不跌 denies risk, which is the RISK_REMOVED relation.
disputes.reason_b: Guide §financial_guarantee: "只涨不跌" denies risk, so the relation is RISK_REMOVED. The article only reports that courses relay the phrase as a premise needing no verification; it does not assert the protection itself, so no category survives.

text: Get into the vault before the halving and let the auto-compounder do the rest, since nobody has ever lost principal here. (Rewards are variable, crypto assets are uninsured, and you can lose money.)

disputes.reason_b: Guide, investment_advice: Get into the vault is an imperative aimed at the reader with a financial object, and before the halving supplies the deadline pressure of emotional_manipulation.
